_meta.description: Beat score for the primitives sequence. Each beat declares an intent in the curriculum's argument; maps express it freely. A beat may have 0, 1, or many maps. Edit any beat; re-run tools/beat_audit.py to check coverage.

beats.concept: the point — a position with no extension; the atomic primitive
the line — points in sequence; the first compositional operation
the trace — the player's own walk leaves a line
lines composed into grids — arrays of arrays
beats.note: this beat openly previews array_tutorial — the grid IS an array

beats.concept: the triangle — three lines compose a closed primitive
the platonic solids — closed primitives in three dimensions
the animated cube — motion enters; the primitive becomes a state in time
beats.note: transformation + wavefunctions bleed backward into primitives so the player feels what comes next

beats.concept: between the geometric and the philosophical — let the primitives settle
beats.note: intentional empty beat; can be expressed as breathing-room region inside Primitives_Ignorance or as its own room

beats.concept: Primitives_Ignorance — what the primitive cannot see; the dark spot in the substrate
beats.note: early bleed from the crisis phase — the limit shows up here as a foreshadowing

beats.concept: Primitives_Portals — topology bleeds in; the primitive's surface is also a passage
Melencolia — the primitive that refuses to be solved; the puzzle that resists
beats.note: the most negative-register beat in the sequence; deliberate anti-pattern. Bilateral symmetry around an irresolvable centre.

beats.concept: first catalyst encounter — bracelet pickup; foe creatures introduced
